selection: Earliest printed measure/onset singleton eighth note with one FLAG_1, explicit RIGHT head-stem and flag-stem edges, upward MusicXML stem, no beams/ties/articulations/fermatas/dots/explicit accidental or other unsupported attachment. No outcome-based replacement.
scope: One isolated flagged eighth-note atomic group, not a whole measure. Other events explicitly excluded. Sixteenth/double flags and downward flags remain unsupported in this run.
flag_glyph: FreeSerif U+1D16E COMBINING FLAG-1, same font size as calibrated notehead. No hand-drawn approximate hook or reference fitting.
attachment: Canonical fixed-phase raster, leftmost occupied column's first ink pixel is the upward-stem attachment anchor. Translate via unchanged GT05 glyph placement. Stem tip integer-rounded with floor(t+.5). Require exact ink contact and zero head/flag intersection.
stem: RIGHT head-stem relation fixes upward direction. Length max(3.5 interlines, corrected semantic source y minus persisted source stem top). Preserve source x and target semantic pitch y; report actual bitmap centers separately.
source_free_controls: Same fixed font at size 94, requested head (180+phase,230+phase) for phases 0,.125,.5,.875. Derive stem column from head raster, use integer tip y=140, require positive head/stem and stem/flag contact, no head/flag overlap, all actual notehead residuals <=.5. Run before score rendering.
protection: Unchanged envelopes; report potential contacts, never infer confirmed lyric ownership. No composition or original erasure.
regressions: Rerender GT05 controls and GT06 atomic beams to separate new directories; all PNGs must be byte-identical to frozen historical PNGs. GT06 protection failure must remain a failure.
reference: Freeze predictions before development comparison; no target pixels used in construction. No independent human accuracy denominator.
stopping: No threshold/collision relaxation or case reselection after outcomes. Unsupported required notation blocks.
